privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What information Lightlist collects, how it is used, which external services receive it, and how long it is kept.
intro: Lightlist (the "Service") handles your information as described below.

sections.heading: Information we collect
list: Account information: your email address. Your password is managed by the authentication provider (Firebase Authentication), and the operator cannot see it.
Content you save: task lists, tasks, and settings such as language and theme.
Usage data: feature usage events, error categories, and technical information such as device and browser type. This does not include task content, email addresses, or share codes.
Crash data (iPhone and Android apps): diagnostic information recorded when the app crashes, linked to your internal account ID.

sections.heading: How we use it
list: To provide the Service and sync your data across devices
To verify your identity, reset your password, and change your email address
To fix problems and improve quality

sections.heading: Sharing
body: When you create a share code for a task list, anyone who knows its URL can view the list without logging in. Removing the share code ends that access.
Users who join a list can edit its content.

sections.heading: External services
body: The operator does not sell your information, show ads, or track you for advertising.

The Service uses the external services below, and your information is processed on their servers, which may be located outside your country. We do not provide your information to any other third party unless required by law.
list: Google (Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, Google Analytics for Firebase, Firebase Crashlytics)
Cloudflare (website delivery; IP addresses and similar data are processed when you access the site)

sections.heading: Storage on your device
body: To work offline, the Service stores your task lists and settings on your device or in your browser. Device storage is also used to keep you logged in and to remember display settings.

sections.heading: Retention and deletion
body: Your information is kept until you delete your account. Deleting your account removes your account information, your settings, and the task lists that only you belong to. Shared lists that other users belong to remain available to them.
Usage data and crash data are deleted after the retention period set by Google.
See the "Delete your account and data" page for the steps.

sections.heading: Access, correction, and deletion
body: You can view and change your email address and saved content in the app at any time. For other requests to access, correct, or delete your information, contact us at the address below.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: If we change this policy, we will announce it on this page.

sections.heading: Contact
body: Operator: khirayama
Email: support@lightlist.app

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The terms, prohibited conduct, and disclaimers that apply to using Lightlist.
intro: These Terms of Service (the "Terms") set out the conditions for using Lightlist (the "Service"). By using the Service, you agree to these Terms.

sections.heading: Account
body: You need to sign up with an email address to use the Service. You are responsible for managing your account.

sections.heading: Your content
body: You keep the rights to the tasks and other content you save. The operator stores and processes that content only as needed to provide the Service.
A list with a share code can be viewed by anyone who knows its URL. You are responsible for deciding what to share and with whom.

sections.heading: Prohibited conduct
list: Unauthorized access or anything else that interferes with the operation of the Service
Using another person's account without permission

sections.heading: Fees
body: The Service is currently provided free of charge.

sections.heading: Changes, suspension, and termination
body: The operator may change the Service, or suspend or end it, without prior notice.
If you violate these Terms, the operator may suspend or delete your account.

sections.heading: Disclaimer
body: The Service is provided as is. The operator does not guarantee that it is complete, accurate, or continuously available.
The operator is not liable for damages arising from use of the Service, except in cases of intent or gross negligence.

sections.heading: Changes to these Terms
body: If we change these Terms, we will announce it on this page. By using the Service after a change, you agree to the changed Terms.

sections.heading: Governing law and jurisdiction
body: These Terms are governed by the laws of Japan. Any dispute relating to the Service is subject to the exclusive jurisdiction, in the first instance, of the court with jurisdiction over the operator's location.

sections.heading: Contact
body: Email: support@lightlist.app

support.title: Support
support.description: How to contact Lightlist, reset your password, and delete your account.
intro: Contact us with questions about using Lightlist or to report a problem.

sections.heading: Contact
body: Email: support@lightlist.app
When reporting a problem, please include your device, OS, and browser, and describe what happened.

sections.heading: If you forgot your password
body: You can send a password reset email from the login screen.

sections.heading: Deleting your account
body: You can delete your account from the settings screen in the app. See the "Delete your account and data" page for the steps.

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
body: For pricing, sharing, and supported devices, see "Frequently asked questions" on the home page.

accountDeletion.title: Delete your account and data
accountDeletion.description: How to delete your Lightlist account and its data, and which data is deleted.
intro: This page explains how to delete your Lightlist account and the data linked to it. Deletion cannot be undone.

sections.heading: Delete from the app
body: The steps are the same on the web (https://lightlist.app/), the iPhone app, and the Android app.
steps: Enter your password on the confirmation screen and delete the account.

sections.heading: If you cannot log in
body: Email support@lightlist.app from your registered email address and tell us you want to delete your account. We will delete it after confirming that the request comes from you.

sections.heading: Data that is deleted
list: Task lists that only you belong to, along with their tasks and share codes

sections.heading: Data that is not deleted
list: Shared lists that other users belong to. They remain available to those users, and you are removed from the list's members.
Usage data and crash data. They are deleted after the retention period set by Google.
